en-US.title: The Constitution in Daily Life, Getting Closer Again | ‘The Constitution Returns on July 17, Shin...
en-US.description:
The Constitution is not merely a text found in textbooks,

but the closest promise that has protected our daily lives.

The Ministry of Government Legislation is conducting a nationwide campaign titled "Returned 0717: The Constitution Shines on the People" to reflect on the value and meaning of the Constitution together with the public.

This campaign runs from May until Constitution Day on July 17 and features various public participation programs, including guerrilla lectures on the Constitution at Gwanghwamun, a Constitution transcription challenge, and planned content featuring the voices of 717 citizens.

The Constitution illuminates the freedom and rights of the people; please reflect once again on its precious value with the Ministry of Government Legislation.

id.title: Konstitusi dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari, Semakin Dekat Kembali | ‘Konstitusi Kembali pada 17 Juli,...
id.description:
Konstitusi bukan sekadar kalimat dalam buku teks,

tetapi janji terdekat yang telah melindungi kehidupan kita sehari-hari.

Kementerian Perundang-undangan Pemerintahan sedang mengadakan kampanye nasional bert名为 "Kembalinya 0717: Konstitusi Bersinar di Atas Rakyat" untuk merenungkan nilai dan makna Konstitusi bersama masyarakat.

Kampanye ini berlangsung dari bulan Mei hingga Hari Konstitusi pada tanggal 17 Juli dan menampilkan berbagai program partisipasi publik, termasuk kuliah gerilya tentang Konstitusi di Gwanghwamun, tantangan transkripsi Konstitusi, dan konten yang direncanakan menampilkan suara warga negara 717.

Konstitusi menerangi kebebasan dan hak-hak rakyat; mohon renungkan sekali lagi nilai berharga Konstitusi bersama Kementerian Perundang-undangan Pemerintahan.

snippet.description:
전통시장인데도
온누리상품권을 못 받는 가게가 있다면 믿으시겠습니까?

규제는 더 나은 제도를 만들기 위해 존재하지만,
현장에서는 예상치 못한 불편을 낳기도 합니다.

시장 입구에 있지만 ‘구획’이 다르다는 이유로
온누리상품권 사용이 불가능한 상인,
가게를 조금 넓히려 해도
300명 넘는 동의를 받아야 하는 현실.

작은 변화에도
‘신규 시장 등록’과 같은 절차를 다시 밟아야 하는 제도,
과연 합리적일까요?

정부는 이러한 불합리한 규제를 개선하기 위해
법 개정과 함께 시행령 보완 방안도 검토 중입니다.

국민의 삶을 바꾸는 법,
현장에서 답을 찾겠습니다.

[공동기획 : SBS Biz X 법제처]

en-US.title: [SBS Biz X Ministry of Government Legislation] A Traditional Market That Doesn't Accept Onnuri Gi...
en-US.description:
Would you believe it if I told you there are shops in traditional markets that do not accept Onnuri Gift Certificates?

Regulations exist to create better systems, but in practice, they can also cause unexpected inconveniences.

Merchants who are unable to accept Onnuri Gift Certificates simply because their shop is located at the market entrance but falls under a different "district," and the reality where one must obtain the consent of over 300 people just to slightly expand their store.

Is a system that requires going through procedures like "new market registration" again for even the smallest changes truly reasonable?

To address these unreasonable regulations, the government is reviewing measures to supplement the enforcement decree alongside amendments to the law.

Laws that change the lives of the people—we will find the answers on the ground.

[Joint Feature: SBS Biz X Ministry of Government Legislation]

en-US.title: People who endured the pain... Now things are changing | Wise Questions & Answers💡
en-US.description:
There are 12,725 homeless people in Korea.

Among those staying in social welfare facilities, 4 out of 10 are elderly people aged 65 or older.

Health problems such as metabolic diseases, mental illnesses, and dental diseases are emerging, but because the threshold to hospitals remains high, "enduring the pain" has become a familiar part of daily life.

Is there no way to resolve the issues on the ground in these blind spots? 😢

------------------------------------

Therefore, the Ministry of Government Legislation has stepped forward! By reorganizing unreasonable administrative legislation,

'On-site Health Checkups' are now starting, where medical institutions visit facilities directly.

🩺

Over 8,400 facilities nationwide, serving approximately 260,000 people,

Now, even marginalized neighbors can receive checkups comfortably within the facilities.

❤️‍🩹

The Ministry of Government Legislation has pushed for over 50 regulatory improvements, including this case.

⚖️

Listening to problems on the ground and finding wise solutions.

💡 [Hyun-Q&A] continues.
